<?php
function nval(int $n): array
{
    return ["N", $n];
}
function sval(string $s): array
{
    return ["S", $s];
}
function eval_error(string $s): array
{
    return ["E", $s];
}
function reference(int $c, int $r, int $f = 0): array
{
    return ["R", $c, $r, $f];
}
function cell_id(array $r): int
{
    return $r[2] * 26 + $r[1];
}
function label(int $i): string
{
    return chr(65 + ($i % 26)) . (intdiv($i, 26) + 1);
}
function inside(array $r): bool
{
    return $r[1] >= 0 && $r[1] < 26 && $r[2] >= 0 && $r[2] < 99;
}
function make_range(array $a, array $b): array
{
    [, $c, $r, $f] = $a;
    [, $d, $t, $g] = $b;
    $ac = $f & 1;
    $ar = $f & 2;
    $bc = $g & 1;
    $br = $g & 2;
    if ($c > $d) {
        [$c, $d, $ac, $bc] = [$d, $c, $bc, $ac];
    }
    if ($r > $t) {
        [$r, $t, $ar, $br] = [$t, $r, $br, $ar];
    }
    return ["G", reference($c, $r, $ac | $ar), reference($d, $t, $bc | $br)];
}
function address(string $s): array
{
    if (!preg_match("/\A[A-Z][1-9][0-9]?\z/", $s)) {
        throw new RuntimeException("bad address");
    }
    return reference(ord($s[0]) - 65, (int) substr($s, 1) - 1);
}
function area(string $s): array
{
    $p = explode(":", $s);
    if (count($p) > 2) {
        throw new RuntimeException("bad address");
    }
    $a = address($p[0]);
    $b = count($p) === 1 ? $a : address($p[1]);
    return make_range($a, $b);
}
function cells(array $g): array
{
    $out = [];
    for ($r = $g[1][2]; $r <= $g[2][2]; $r++) {
        for ($c = $g[1][1]; $c <= $g[2][1]; $c++) {
            $out[] = $r * 26 + $c;
        };
    }
    return $out;
}
function contains_cell(array $g, array $r): bool
{
    return $r[1] >= $g[1][1] && $r[1] <= $g[2][1] && $r[2] >= $g[1][2] && $r[2] <= $g[2][2];
}
const LEVELS = [["=", "<>", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], ["&"], ["+", "-"], ["*", "/"]];
function precedence(string $op): int
{
    foreach (LEVELS as $i => $xs) {
        if (in_array($op, $xs, true)) {
            return $i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}
final class Parser
{
    private array $tokens = [];
    private int $at = 0;
    private function syntax(int $p): never
    {
        throw new RuntimeException("syntax error at $p");
    }
    public function __construct(string $s)
    {
        $i = 1;
        $len = strlen($s);
        while ($i < $len) {
            $p = $i + 1;
            $ch = $s[$i];
            if ($ch === " ") {
                $i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (ctype_digit($ch)) {
                $j = $i;
                while ($j < $len && ctype_digit($s[$j])) {
                    $j++;
                }
                if ($j - $i >= 10) {
                    $this->syntax($p);
                }
                $x = nval((int) substr($s, $i, $j - $i));
                $i = $j;
            } elseif ($ch === '"') {
                $j = strpos($s, '"', $i + 1);
                if ($j === false) {
                    $this->syntax($p);
                }
                $x = sval(substr($s, $i + 1, $j - $i - 1));
                $i = $j + 1;
            } elseif (ctype_alpha($ch) || $ch === '$') {
                $j = $i;
                while ($j < $len && (ctype_alnum($s[$j]) || $s[$j] === '$')) {
                    $j++;
                }
                $w = strtoupper(substr($s, $i, $j - $i));
                $i = $j;
                if (preg_match('/\A(\$?)([A-Z])(\$?)([1-9][0-9]?)\z/', $w, $m)) {
                    $x = reference(
                        ord($m[2]) - 65,
                        (int) $m[4] - 1,
                        ($m[1] !== "" ? 1 : 0) | ($m[3] !== "" ? 2 : 0),
                    );
                } elseif (preg_match("/\A[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*\z/", $w)) {
                    $x = [str_starts_with(ltrim(substr($s, $i), " "), "(") ? "C" : "W", $w];
                } else {
                    $this->syntax($p);
                }
            } else {
                $op = substr($s, $i, 2);
                if (!in_array($op, ["<>", "<=", ">="], true)) {
                    $op = $ch;
                }
                if (!str_contains("+-*/&(),:=<>", $ch)) {
                    $this->syntax($p);
                }
                $x = ["T", $op];
                $i += strlen($op);
            }
            $this->tokens[] = [$x, $p];
        }
        $this->tokens[] = [["Z"], $len + 1];
    }
    private function take(string $op): bool
    {
        if ($this->tokens[$this->at][0] === ["T", $op]) {
            $this->at++;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    private function expect(string $op): void
    {
        if (!$this->take($op)) {
            $this->syntax($this->tokens[$this->at][1]);
        }
    }
    private function expression(int $level = 0): array
    {
        if ($level === 4) {
            return $this->primary();
        }
        $a = $this->expression($level + 1);
        while (
            $this->tokens[$this->at][0][0] === "T" &&
            in_array($this->tokens[$this->at][0][1], LEVELS[$level], true)
        ) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->at++][0][1];
            $a = ["B", $op, $a, $this->expression($level + 1)];
        }
        return $a;
    }
    private function primary(): array
    {
        if ($this->take("-")) {
            return ["U", $this->primary()];
        }
        [$x, $p] = $this->tokens[$this->at++];
        if (in_array($x[0], ["N", "S", "W"], true)) {
            return $x;
        }
        if ($x[0] === "R") {
            if (!$this->take(":")) {
                return $x;
            }
            if ($this->tokens[$this->at][0][0] !== "R") {
                $this->syntax($this->tokens[$this->at][1]);
            }
            return make_range($x, $this->tokens[$this->at++][0]);
        }
        if ($x[0] === "C") {
            $this->expect("(");
            $args = [];
            if (!$this->take(")")) {
                $args[] = $this->expression();
                while ($this->take(",")) {
                    $args[] = $this->expression();
                }
                $this->expect(")");
            }
            return ["F", $x[1], $args];
        }
        if ($x === ["T", "("]) {
            $a = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(")");
            return $a;
        }
        $this->syntax($p);
    }
    public function parse(): array
    {
        $x = $this->expression();
        if ($this->tokens[$this->at][0][0] !== "Z") {
            $this->syntax($this->tokens[$this->at][1]);
        }
        return $x;
    }
}
function canonical(array $x): string
{
    switch ($x[0]) {
        case "N":
            return (string) $x[1];
        case "S":
            return '"' . $x[1] . '"';
        case "W":
            return $x[1];
        case "X":
            return "#REF!";
        case "R":
            return ($x[3] & 1 ? '$' : "") . chr(65 + $x[1]) . ($x[3] & 2 ? '$' : "") . ($x[2] + 1);
        case "G":
            return canonical($x[1]) . ":" . canonical($x[2]);
        case "F":
            return $x[1] . "(" . implode(",", array_map("canonical", $x[2])) . ")";
        case "U":
            return "-" . ($x[1][0] === "B" ? "(" . canonical($x[1]) . ")" : canonical($x[1]));
        case "B":
            $a = canonical($x[2]);
            $b = canonical($x[3]);
            if ($x[2][0] === "B" && precedence($x[2][1]) < precedence($x[1])) {
                $a = "($a)";
            }
            if ($x[3][0] === "B" && precedence($x[3][1]) <= precedence($x[1])) {
                $b = "($b)";
            }
            return $a . $x[1] . $b;
    }
    throw new LogicException("invalid tree");
}
function display(?array $x): string
{
    return $x === null ? "" : (string) $x[1];
}
function notation(?array $x): string
{
    return $x === null
        ? "(empty)"
        : ($x[0] === "="
            ? "=" . canonical($x[1])
            : ($x[0] === "S"
                ? '"' . $x[1] . '"'
                : display($x)));
}
function to_number(?array $x): array
{
    return $x === null ? nval(0) : (in_array($x[0], ["S", "G"], true) ? eval_error("#VALUE!") : $x);
}
function to_string(?array $x): array
{
    return $x === null
        ? sval("")
        : ($x[0] === "N"
            ? sval((string) $x[1])
            : ($x[0] === "G"
                ? eval_error("#VALUE!")
                : $x));
}
function rewrite(?array $x, callable $f): ?array
{
    if ($x === null) {
        return null;
    }
    switch ($x[0]) {
        case "R":
        case "G":
            return $f($x);
        case "F":
            return ["F", $x[1], array_map(fn($a) => rewrite($a, $f), $x[2])];
        case "B":
            return ["B", $x[1], rewrite($x[2], $f), rewrite($x[3], $f)];
        case "U":
        case "=":
            return [$x[0], rewrite($x[1], $f)];
        default:
            return $x;
    }
}
function dependencies(?array $x, array &$out): void
{
    if ($x === null) {
        return;
    }
    switch ($x[0]) {
        case "R":
            $out[cell_id($x)] = true;
            break;
        case "G":
            foreach (cells($x) as $i) {
                $out[$i] = true;
            }
            break;
        case "F":
            foreach ($x[2] as $a) {
                dependencies($a, $out);
            }
            break;
        case "B":
            dependencies($x[2], $out);
            dependencies($x[3], $out);
            break;
        case "U":
        case "=":
            dependencies($x[1], $out);
    }
}
final class Sheet
{
    private array $contents;
    private array $values;
    private array $deps;
    private array $history = [];
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->contents = array_fill(0, 2574, null);
        $this->values = $this->contents;
        $this->deps = array_fill(0, 2574, []);
    }
    private function evaluate(array $x): ?array
    {
        switch ($x[0]) {
            case "N":
            case "S":
            case "G":
                return $x;
            case "R":
                return $this->values[cell_id($x)];
            case "W":
                return eval_error("#NAME?");
            case "X":
                return eval_error("#REF!");
            case "U":
                $a = to_number($this->evaluate($x[1]));
                return $a[0] === "E" ? $a : nval(-$a[1]);
            case "B":
                $a = $this->evaluate($x[2]);
                $b = $this->evaluate($x[3]);
                if (($a[0] ?? "") === "E") {
                    return $a;
                }
                if (($b[0] ?? "") === "E") {
                    return $b;
                }
                $op = $x[1];
                if (precedence($op) === 0) {
                    if (($a[0] ?? "") === "G" || ($b[0] ?? "") === "G") {
                        return eval_error("#VALUE!");
                    }
                    $blank = ($a[0] ?? "") === "S" || ($b[0] ?? "") === "S" ? sval("") : nval(0);
                    $a ??= $blank;
                    $b ??= $blank;
                    $c =
                        $a[0] !== $b[0]
                            ? ($a[0] === "N"
                                ? -1
                                : 1)
                            : ($a[0] === "N"
                                ? $a[1] <=> $b[1]
                                : strcmp($a[1], $b[1]));
                    return nval(
                        (int) match ($op) {
                            "=" => $c === 0,
                            "<>" => $c !== 0,
                            "<" => $c < 0,
                            "<=" => $c <= 0,
                            ">" => $c > 0,
                            default => $c >= 0,
                        },
                    );
                }
                $a = $op === "&" ? to_string($a) : to_number($a);
                $b = $op === "&" ? to_string($b) : to_number($b);
                if ($a[0] === "E") {
                    return $a;
                }
                if ($b[0] === "E") {
                    return $b;
                }
                return match ($op) {
                    "&" => sval($a[1] . $b[1]),
                    "+" => nval($a[1] + $b[1]),
                    "-" => nval($a[1] - $b[1]),
                    "*" => nval($a[1] * $b[1]),
                    default => $b[1] === 0 ? eval_error("#DIV/0!") : nval(intdiv($a[1], $b[1])),
                };
            case "F":
                return $this->call($x[1], $x[2]);
        }
        throw new LogicException("invalid expression");
    }
    private function call(string $name, array $args): ?array
    {
        if (
            in_array($name, ["SUM", "MIN", "MAX", "COUNT", "AVERAGE", "AND", "OR", "CONCAT"], true)
        ) {
            if (!$args) {
                return eval_error("#VALUE!");
            }
            $items = [];
            $ns = [];
            foreach ($args as $a) {
                $v = $this->evaluate($a);
                if (($v[0] ?? "") === "G") {
                    foreach (cells($v) as $i) {
                        $items[] = $this->values[$i];
                    }
                } else {
                    $items[] = $v;
                }
            }
            foreach ($items as $v) {
                if (($v[0] ?? "") === "N") {
                    $ns[] = $v[1];
                }
            }
            if ($name === "COUNT") {
                return nval(count($ns));
            }
            foreach ($items as $v) {
                if (($v[0] ?? "") === "E") {
                    return $v;
                }
            }
            return match ($name) {
                "SUM" => nval(array_sum($ns)),
                "MIN" => nval($ns ? min($ns) : 0),
                "MAX" => nval($ns ? max($ns) : 0),
                "AVERAGE" => $ns ? nval(intdiv(array_sum($ns), count($ns))) : eval_error("#DIV/0!"),
                "AND" => $ns ? nval((int) !in_array(0, $ns, true)) : eval_error("#VALUE!"),
                "OR" => $ns
                    ? nval((int) (count(array_filter($ns, fn($n) => $n !== 0)) > 0))
                    : eval_error("#VALUE!"),
                default => sval(implode("", array_map(fn($v) => to_string($v)[1], $items))),
            };
        }
        if ($name === "IF") {
            if (!in_array(count($args), [2, 3], true)) {
                return eval_error("#VALUE!");
            }
            $c = to_number($this->evaluate($args[0]));
            if ($c[0] === "E") {
                return $c;
            }
            return $c[1] !== 0
                ? $this->evaluate($args[1])
                : (count($args) === 3
                    ? $this->evaluate($args[2])
                    : nval(0));
        }
        if (!in_array($name, ["ABS", "NOT", "LEN"], true)) {
            return eval_error("#NAME?");
        }
        if (count($args) !== 1) {
            return eval_error("#VALUE!");
        }
        $v = $this->evaluate($args[0]);
        $v = $name === "LEN" ? to_string($v) : to_number($v);
        return $v[0] === "E"
            ? $v
            : nval(
                $name === "LEN"
                    ? strlen($v[1])
                    : ($name === "ABS"
                        ? abs($v[1])
                        : (int) ($v[1] === 0)),
            );
    }
    private function recalculate(): void
    {
        $indices = array_fill(0, 2574, -1);
        $low = [];
        $on = [];
        $stack = [];
        $cyclic = [];
        $serial = 0;
        for ($i = 0; $i < 2574; $i++) {
            $this->deps[$i] = [];
            if (($this->contents[$i][0] ?? "") === "=") {
                dependencies($this->contents[$i][1], $this->deps[$i]);
                $this->values[$i] = null;
            } else {
                $this->values[$i] = $this->contents[$i];
            }
        }
        $visit = function (int $i) use (
            &$visit,
            &$indices,
            &$low,
            &$on,
            &$stack,
            &$cyclic,
            &$serial,
        ): void {
            $indices[$i] = $low[$i] = $serial++;
            $stack[] = $i;
            $on[$i] = true;
            foreach ($this->deps[$i] as $j => $_) {
                if (($this->contents[$j][0] ?? "") === "=") {
                    if ($indices[$j] < 0) {
                        $visit($j);
                        $low[$i] = min($low[$i], $low[$j]);
                    } elseif (isset($on[$j])) {
                        $low[$i] = min($low[$i], $indices[$j]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if ($low[$i] === $indices[$i]) {
                $part = [];
                do {
                    $j = array_pop($stack);
                    unset($on[$j]);
                    $part[] = $j;
                } while ($j !== $i);
                if (count($part) > 1 || isset($this->deps[$i][$i])) {
                    foreach ($part as $j) {
                        $cyclic[$j] = true;
                    };
                }
            }
        };
        for ($i = 0; $i < 2574; $i++) {
            if (($this->contents[$i][0] ?? "") === "=" && $indices[$i] < 0) {
                $visit($i);
            }
        }
        $done = [];
        $calculate = function (int $i) use (&$calculate, &$done, $cyclic): void {
            if (($this->contents[$i][0] ?? "") !== "=" || isset($done[$i])) {
                return;
            }
            $done[$i] = true;
            if (isset($cyclic[$i])) {
                $this->values[$i] = eval_error("#CYCLE!");
                return;
            }
            foreach ($this->deps[$i] as $j => $_) {
                $calculate($j);
            }
            $v = $this->evaluate($this->contents[$i][1]);
            $this->values[$i] =
                $v === null ? nval(0) : ($v[0] === "G" ? eval_error("#VALUE!") : $v);
        };
        for ($i = 0; $i < 2574; $i++) {
            $calculate($i);
        }
    }
    private function replace(array $next): int
    {
        $old = $this->values;
        $this->contents = $next;
        $this->recalculate();
        $n = 0;
        foreach ($old as $i => $v) {
            $n += (int) ($v !== $this->values[$i]);
        }
        return $n;
    }
    private function describe(int $i): string
    {
        return label($i) .
            ": " .
            notation($this->contents[$i]) .
            " -> " .
            notation($this->values[$i]);
    }
    public function execute(string $line): array
    {
        [$name, $rest] = array_pad(explode(" ", $line, 2), 2, "");
        if ($name === "SHOW") {
            return [$this->describe(cell_id(address($rest)))];
        }
        if ($name === "LIST") {
            $out = [];
            foreach ($this->contents as $i => $v) {
                if ($v !== null) {
                    $out[] = $this->describe($i);
                }
            }
            return $out ?: ["(no cells)"];
        }
        if ($name === "DEPS") {
            $i = cell_id(address($rest));
            $ps = array_keys($this->deps[$i]);
            sort($ps, SORT_NUMERIC);
            $ds = [];
            foreach ($this->deps as $j => $xs) {
                if (isset($xs[$i])) {
                    $ds[] = $j;
                }
            }
            $format = fn($xs) => $xs ? implode(",", array_map("label", $xs)) : "none";
            return [$rest . ": precedents=" . $format($ps) . " dependents=" . $format($ds)];
        }
        if ($name === "PRINT") {
            $g = area($rest);
            $rw = strlen((string) ($g[2][2] + 1));
            $ws = [];
            $sep = "+" . str_repeat("-", $rw) . "+";
            $head = "|" . str_repeat(" ", $rw) . "|";
            for ($c = $g[1][1]; $c <= $g[2][1]; $c++) {
                $w = 1;
                for ($r = $g[1][2]; $r <= $g[2][2]; $r++) {
                    $w = max($w, strlen(display($this->values[$r * 26 + $c])));
                }
                $ws[] = $w;
                $sep .= str_repeat("-", $w) . "+";
                $head .= str_pad(chr(65 + $c), $w) . "|";
            }
            $out = [$sep, $head, $sep];
            for ($r = $g[1][2]; $r <= $g[2][2]; $r++) {
                $s = "|" . str_pad((string) ($r + 1), $rw, " ", STR_PAD_LEFT) . "|";
                foreach ($ws as $j => $w) {
                    $v = $this->values[$r * 26 + $g[1][1] + $j];
                    $s .=
                        str_pad(
                            display($v),
                            $w,
                            " ",
                            ($v[0] ?? "") === "N" ? STR_PAD_LEFT : STR_PAD_RIGHT,
                        ) . "|";
                }
                $out[] = $s;
            }
            $out[] = $sep;
            return $out;
        }
        if ($name === "UNDO") {
            if (!$this->history) {
                throw new RuntimeException("nothing to undo");
            }
            [$command, $old] = array_pop($this->history);
            return ["UNDO " . $command . " changed=" . $this->replace($old)];
        }
        $next = $this->contents;
        $target = -1;
        if ($name === "SET") {
            [$a, $s] = explode(" ", $rest, 2);
            $target = cell_id(address($a));
            if ($s[0] === "=") {
                $next[$target] = ["=", new Parser($s)->parse()];
            } elseif (preg_match('/\A"[^"]*"\z/', $s)) {
                $next[$target] = sval(substr($s, 1, -1));
            } elseif (preg_match("/\A(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\z/", $s)) {
                $next[$target] = nval((int) $s);
            } else {
                throw new RuntimeException("bad value");
            }
        } elseif ($name === "CLEAR") {
            foreach (cells(area($rest)) as $i) {
                $next[$i] = null;
            }
        } elseif ($name === "COPY" || $name === "MOVE") {
            [$a, $b] = explode(" ", $rest);
            $source = area($a);
            $dest = address($b);
            $dc = $dest[1] - $source[1][1];
            $dr = $dest[2] - $source[1][2];
            $shift = fn($r, $rel) => reference(
                $r[1] + ($rel && $r[3] & 1 ? 0 : $dc),
                $r[2] + ($rel && $r[3] & 2 ? 0 : $dr),
                $r[3],
            );
            $destination = make_range($shift($source[1], false), $shift($source[2], false));
            if (!inside($destination[1]) || !inside($destination[2])) {
                throw new RuntimeException("out of grid");
            }
            $transform = function ($x) use ($name, $source, $destination, $shift) {
                if ($x[0] === "R") {
                    if ($name === "COPY") {
                        $r = $shift($x, true);
                        return inside($r) ? $r : ["X"];
                    }
                    return contains_cell($source, $x)
                        ? $shift($x, false)
                        : (contains_cell($destination, $x)
                            ? ["X"]
                            : $x);
                }
                if (
                    $name === "MOVE" &&
                    !(contains_cell($source, $x[1]) && contains_cell($source, $x[2]))
                ) {
                    return $x;
                }
                $a = $shift($x[1], $name === "COPY");
                $b = $shift($x[2], $name === "COPY");
                return inside($a) && inside($b) ? make_range($a, $b) : ["X"];
            };
            if ($name === "MOVE") {
                $next = array_map(fn($x) => rewrite($x, $transform), $next);
            }
            $moving = [];
            foreach (cells($source) as $i) {
                $moving[] = [
                    $i,
                    $name === "COPY" ? rewrite($this->contents[$i], $transform) : $next[$i],
                ];
            }
            if ($name === "MOVE") {
                foreach ($moving as [$i, $_]) {
                    $next[$i] = null;
                };
            }
            foreach ($moving as [$i, $x]) {
                $next[$i + $dr * 26 + $dc] = $x;
            }
        } elseif (in_array($name, ["INSERTROW", "DELETEROW", "INSERTCOL", "DELETECOL"], true)) {
            $row = str_ends_with($name, "ROW");
            $insert = str_starts_with($name, "INSERT");
            if (!preg_match($row ? "/\A[1-9][0-9]?\z/" : "/\A[A-Z]\z/", $rest)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("bad address");
            }
            $at = $row ? (int) $rest - 1 : ord($rest) - 65;
            $limit = $row ? 99 : 26;
            $axis = fn($x) => $x[$row ? 2 : 1];
            $change = fn($x, $v) => $row
                ? reference($x[1], $v, $x[3])
                : reference($v, $x[2], $x[3]);
            if ($insert) {
                foreach ($this->contents as $i => $x) {
                    if ($x !== null && ($row ? intdiv($i, 26) : $i % 26) === $limit - 1) {
                        throw new RuntimeException(
                            "last " . ($row ? "row" : "column") . " not empty",
                        );
                    }
                };
            }
            $transform = function ($x) use ($insert, $at, $limit, $axis, $change) {
                if ($x[0] === "R") {
                    $v = $axis($x);
                    if (!$insert && $v === $at) {
                        return ["X"];
                    }
                    $n = $v + ($insert ? (int) ($v >= $at) : -(int) ($v > $at));
                    return $n >= $limit ? ["X"] : $change($x, $n);
                }
                $a = $axis($x[1]);
                $b = $axis($x[2]);
                if (!$insert && $a === $at && $b === $at) {
                    return ["X"];
                }
                $u = $a + ($insert ? (int) ($a >= $at) : -(int) ($a > $at));
                $v = $b + ($insert ? (int) ($b >= $at) : -(int) ($b >= $at));
                return $v >= $limit ? ["X"] : make_range($change($x[1], $u), $change($x[2], $v));
            };
            $next = array_fill(0, 2574, null);
            foreach ($this->contents as $i => $x) {
                if ($x !== null) {
                    $r = reference($i % 26, intdiv($i, 26));
                    $v = $axis($r);
                    if (!$insert && $v === $at) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $t = $change($r, $v + ($insert ? (int) ($v >= $at) : -(int) ($v > $at)));
                    $next[cell_id($t)] = rewrite($x, $transform);
                }
            }
        } else {
            throw new RuntimeException("unknown command");
        }
        $this->history[] = [$name, $this->contents];
        $changed = $this->replace($next);
        return [
            $name .
            ($name === "SET" ? " " . label($target) . "=" . notation($this->values[$target]) : "") .
            " changed=" .
            $changed,
        ];
    }
}
$n = (int) fgets(STDIN);
$sheet = new Sheet();
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    try {
        $out = $sheet->execute(rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n"));
        echo implode("\n", $out), "\n";
    } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
        echo "ERROR ", $e->getMessage(), "\n";
    }
}
